description.en: The ID of the lightweight database instance.

description.zh:
监控开始时间。按照[ISO 8601](~~25696~~)标准表示，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ。

> +8小时后是控制台上显示的时间。
description.en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the [ISO 8601](~~25696~~) standard in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ` format. The time must be in UTC.

> The time in the console is displayed in UTC+8.

description.zh:
指标名称。取值范围：

- MySQL_MemCpuUsage：实例CPU使用率（占操作系统总数）和MySQL实例内存使用率（占操作系统总数）。
- MySQL_DetailedSpaceUsage：实例总空间使用量、数据空间、日志空间、临时空间和系统空间。
- MySQL_Sessions ：当前活跃连接数，当前总连接数。
- MySQL_IOPS ：实例的IOPS（每秒IO请求次数）。
description.en:
The name of the metric. Valid values:

- `MySQL_MemCpuUsage`: The CPU utilization and memory usage of the instance, as a percentage of the total resources of the operating system.

- `MySQL_DetailedSpaceUsage`: The total, data, log, temporary, and system disk space usage of the instance.

- `MySQL_Sessions`: The number of active and total connections.

- `MySQL_IOPS`: The IOPS of the instance.

description.zh:
指定的轻量数据库实例所属的地域ID。
您可以调用[ListRegions](~~189315~~)查看支持的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID of the lightweight database instance. You can call the [ListRegions](~~189315~~) operation to get the latest list of Alibaba Cloud regions.

description.zh:
监控结束时间。按照[ISO 8601](~~25696~~)标准表示，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ。

> +8小时后是控制台上显示的时间。
description.en:
The start of the time range to query. Specify the time in the [ISO 8601](~~25696~~) standard in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ` format. The time must be in UTC.

> The time in the console is displayed in UTC+8.

title.zh: 查询数据库实例监控信息

descriptions.zh: 创建数据库服务后，您可以查看数据库服务的CPU、内存、磁盘空间和存储IOPS（Input/Output Operations Per Second）和当前总连接数的详细信息。
descriptions.en: After you create a lightweight database instance, you can retrieve its detailed monitoring metrics. These metrics include CPU and memory usage, disk space, IOPS (Input/Output Operations Per Second), and the number of connections.
